integrity: The exact cell scaling and asymptotic tail were derived analytically; numerical computation is used only to evaluate the convergent coefficient and replay the asymptotic constants. Qualitative divergence and the isolated first-cell value \(8/(105h)\) are treated as prior-covered; the original contribution is the exact full nodal-interpolant decomposition and sharp asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Specific to uniform nodal piecewise-affine interpolation of the exact Manià minimizer and exact integration of the original functional; nonuniform meshes, optimized finite-element approximants, and quadrature-discretized energies are not classified.
title: Exact linear energy blow-up for the nodal interpolant in Manià's Lavrentiev example
